channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 31 Aug 2026
Pulitzer Center: Global South Civil Society Microgrants 2026
item.description: Pulitzer Center · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 to USD 4,000 per project. Applicants name the amount requested and submit a draft budget. Funds are transferred to the partner after the agreement is signed; partners file a financial narrative and outcomes report at the end but are NOT required to collect detailed receipts. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Programme Autumn 2027 (Chengdu)
    https://www.a4artmuseum.com/en/a4-residencyartcenter/residing/latest-recruitment/
    A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Studio and accommodation provided; round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget; production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for creative production and material costs (excluding living expenses). No application fee.
